dedupe_keys.name: russia constituent entity co2 emission accounts 2005 2019

description: This Figshare release assembles energy-related and process-related carbon dioxide accounts for Russia and 82 constituent entities between 2005 and 2019. Five workbooks separate the earlier energy series, later annual updates and cement-related process emissions. Regional energy or industrial transition simulations can use the accounts to calibrate historical emissions and compare administrative units. These are calculated inventories, not direct stack measurements. Sector definitions and accounting methods may change across years, so a modeller should inspect workbook notes before stitching files into a time series. The own Figshare item states CC0. I read its file list and the Scientific Data description without opening spreadsheets or reproducing the reported 2,466 records. The related China and Japan accounts cover different countries and are not duplicates. No exact catalogue match was found. A limitation is that administrative emissions totals cannot locate individual stacks or power stations.
